judged_text: perform_retrieve synchronously executes the entire scheduled feed poll inline (`Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})`) on every retrieval miss, fetching and re-processing the whole feed to serve a single-URL request — implementation work not traceable to the 'retrieve this URL' requirement. With feed polling enabled, each first visit to any not-yet-imported page turns the retrieve_topic worker into a full feed fetch+parse+import cycle (in addition to the hourly schedule), so a slow or large feed multiplies worker latency and load scales with the number of distinct embedded pages.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` which, on an embed miss, conditionally runs the scheduled feed poll inline: `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true (lib/topic_retriever.rb). `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` fetches and parses the entire feed via `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates all items importing each (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb). This is a real, diff-grounded architecture/performance concern: a single-URL retrieval can trigger a full feed fetch/import cycle in addition to the hourly schedule, increasing worker latency and load, but it’s not a direct functional correctness defect.
